rules.statement: A document is not duly registered under the Registration of Documents Ordinance if it is entered in a new folio without proper cross-references, even if there are endorsements by the Registrar.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order to avoid these difficulties the Legislature has specifically laid down the manner in which the Registrar should enter cross-references. When a statute prescribes that an act shall be done in a particular manner, the prescribed method should be strictly followed (of. per Basnayake, J. in Sivagurunathan v. Doresamy[1 (7951) 52 N. L. R. 207 at 210.).")
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 15 (1) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, and the regulations made thereunder.
